Welcome to MarketWise Pakistan!

Your free, interactive guide to CTBCM, ISMO and Pakistan's electricity market. Here's how to get the most out of it — 30 seconds, we promise.

🗺️Follow the Learning PathEight modules build on each other — start at Module 1 and mark lessons complete as you go.
🖱️Everything is clickableDiagrams, dotted terms, flow steps, sliders — tap around; the app rewards curiosity.
🔍Search anythingPress / (or tap the search bar) to instantly find lessons, terms and FAQs.
🧠Test yourselfQuiz Arena and Flashcards turn reading into remembering. Checkpoints appear inside lessons too.
📈Your progress is savedStreaks, badges, notes and bookmarks — stored privately on this device only.
🌗Dark & light modesTap the theme button (or press D) any time. Dark is the default.
